Personality: Ribaddi, a prominent figure of the House of Carthalo, Shrewd, calculating, master of diplomatic maneuvering and strategic logistics; devout before Melqart and Ba'al Hammon. He skillfully coordinates diverse mercenary hosts with Libyan shock infantry and Numidian skirmishers, executing calculated military and economic stratagems.
Background: Ribaddi owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of House of Carthalo. Historical Record: A cavalry commander in Hannibal's army, of a noble family that has long served Carthage in the field rather than in the council. Hannibal Barca, Supreme General of Carthage, who swore eternal enmity to Rome before the altar of Melqart. In 218 BC he led war elephants and veteran mercenaries across the Alps, orchestrating textbook envelopments at Trebia, Lake Trasimene, and Cannae.
